$captured.principals: no authentication: every call is the writable positive control
$captured.note: `agent` runs the provider's agent reads and every agent-mode surface, with the broker snapshot and the topic list before and after. `raw` sends each call the agent's closed table never sends, with the broker's own tools, past every Studio check, with the snapshot before and after each principal's calls. `leaks` lists every seeded record marker, broker address, log-directory root and group id an agent answer holds, and must be empty.

consumer_group.unavailable: Agent mode on Kafka reads metadata only, through the Metadata and ListOffsets requests: topic names, partitions, broker node ids and racks, the cluster id, and each partition's earliest and end offsets. Consumer groups (their ids, members, client ids and hosts, committed offsets and lag) are not read in agent mode, so none is listed or counted.

answered.databaseSize: Agent mode on Kafka reads metadata only, through the Metadata and ListOffsets requests: topic names, partitions, broker node ids and racks, the cluster id, and each partition's earliest and end offsets. The size on disk is read from the brokers' log directories, which agent mode does not read, so it is not reported.

storage.refused: QueryError: Agent mode on Kafka reads metadata only, through the Metadata and ListOffsets requests: topic names, partitions, broker node ids and racks, the cluster id, and each partition's earliest and end offsets. sessions.refused: QueryError: Agent mode on Kafka reads metadata only, through the Metadata and ListOffsets requests: topic names, partitions, broker node ids and racks, the cluster id, and each partition's earliest and end offsets. Kafka reports no client sessions over its protocol, so no session reading is taken; this is not a reading of none.
